The user just asked me to “Look for uniqe archetectures now.” They want me to find unique or unusual model architectures that could be relevant to our tiny LLM project. I’ve already done a few broad searches for “novel language model architecture beyond transformer”, “unusual neural architecture language modeling experimental”, and “hierarchical recursive latent reasoning architecture small”, as well as “hybrid state space attention linear architecture language model new”. Those returned a mix of promising papers (Prototype Transformer, NAG, recursive reasoning models, hybrid SSM/attention hybrids) but many of them are either still fairly mainstream extensions of transformers, or focus on larger models, or are more theoretical than practical for a tiny, efficient LLM.

Looking at the results, I see a lot of work on recursive models and hybrids, but I’m missing something that truly stands out as “weird” or unconventional—something that departs from the usual transformer/SSM hybrid paradigm. The user emphasized “unique” and “weird” architectures. I recall seeing recent buzz around energy‑based models (EBMs) being applied to language generation, especially diffusion‑based text models that treat text as a continuous latent and generate via a diffusion process. Those are quite different from the token‑by‑token autoregressive approach and could be considered exotic, especially the newer 2026 papers that combine diffusion with language modeling. Also, there have been papers exploring continuous thought representations and energy landscapes for text generation—these definitely qualify as “weird” architectures.

Given the pattern of my prior searches, I should now specifically target that niche: energy‑based diffusion models for text, continuous latent representations, and any 2026 arXiv papers that frame language modeling as an energy‑based diffusion process. A focused query like “arxiv 2026 weird architecture energy based diffusion text continuous thought” should surface the most relevant recent work. This aligns with the user's request for unique architectures and builds on the prior search direction while narrowing to the truly unconventional approaches. Therefore, I will issue a WebSearch with that exact query.

arguments.query: arxiv 2026 weird architecture energy based diffusion text continuous thought
